# With -html-layout dir every page gets a directory of its own, so a
# plain file server answers for it at a URL with no extension.

md2html -html out -html-layout dir -allow-unsafe -nav -search -llms -site-url https://example.com/docs src
exists out/index.html
exists out/guide/index.html
exists out/api/index.html
exists out/api/client/index.html
! exists out/guide.html
! exists out/api/client.html

# The README is the site index and is not written a second time.
grep -q 'Home body' out/index.html
! exists out/README/index.html
! exists out/README.html

# Pages link to one another by directory.
grep -q 'href="guide/"' out/index.html
grep -q 'href="api/client/#usage"' out/index.html
grep -q 'href="../"' out/guide/index.html
grep -q 'href="../api/"' out/guide/index.html
grep -q 'href="../../guide/"' out/api/client/index.html
grep -q 'href="client/"' out/api/index.html
! grep -q 'href="[^"]*index\.html' out/api/client/index.html

# A page that moved down a directory still finds the files beside its
# source, and the site's own assets.
grep -q 'src="../logo.png"' out/guide/index.html
grep -q 'href="../notes.txt"' out/guide/index.html
grep -q 'href="../logo.png">logo' out/guide/index.html

# A component's link is rewritten once, as a raw HTML tag's is.
grep -q 'href="../api/client/"' out/guide/index.html
! grep -q 'href="../../api/client/"' out/guide/index.html
grep -q 'src="../diagram.png"' out/api/client/index.html
grep -q 'src="diagram.png"' out/api/index.html
grep -q 'src="../js/search\.' out/guide/index.html
grep -q 'src="../../js/search\.' out/api/client/index.html
grep -q 'src="./js/search\.' out/index.html
grep -q 'href="../guide.md"' out/guide/index.html

# Canonical URLs and llms.txt name the directories.
grep -q 'rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/docs/guide/"' out/guide/index.html
grep -q 'rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/docs/api/client/"' out/api/client/index.html
grep -q 'rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/docs/"' out/index.html
grep -q '\[Client\]\(api/client/\)' out/llms.txt
grep -q '\[Home\]\(\./\)' out/llms.txt

# Two sources that would be written to the same file are an error.
cp src/guide.md clash/guide.md
! md2html -html out2 -html-layout dir clash
stderr 'guide/index.html is already written for guide'

# The layout is a property of static output.
! md2html -http :9144 -html-layout dir src
stderr 'html-layout applies to static builds'
! md2html -html out3 -html-layout tree src
stderr 'invalid html-layout "tree"'

# The default layout is unchanged.
md2html -html flat -html-layout file src
exists flat/guide.html
exists flat/api/client.html

-- src/README.md --
